html:
Visiting the incense making village of Quang Phu Cau, will bring visitors unforgettable experiences of a Vietnamese village, a traditional village, not only a destination for sightseeing but also to learn about the unique culture with the people here.

Quang Phu Cau incense making village is located in Ung Hoa district, about 35 km from the center of Hanoi, famous for its centuries-old incense making craft. It is currently a destination that attracts tourists from all over the world to visit and sightsee.

From Hanoi, visitors can travel by motorbike or bus to Quang Phu Cau incense making village. Here, visitors can buy incense or take beautiful photos of themselves in the traditional incense making village.

To take beautiful photos at Quang Phu Cau incense making village, visitors should listen to the weather in advance and choose sunny days to visit and sightsee.

To enter Quang Phu Cau incense village, visitors can pay a fee of about 50,000 VND/person, visitors can visit and take souvenir photos.

Many foreign visitors coming here are very excited by the beautiful scenery of the craft village, a peaceful village will exude its own beauty.

Each stage of making incense is a combination of machinery and manual methods. To serve tourists, the locals here arrange incense into symbols such as flowers and yellow stars, which are very eye-catching.
